title: Government Releases R$ 64.3 Million in Credit for Food Security and Indigenous Peoples
seoTitle: R$ 64.3 million credit for food security and indigenous
subtitle: Provisional Measure Authorizes Funds for Food and Indigenous Communities
excerpt: The federal government has published a provisional measure opening R$ 64.3 million in credit allocated to food security and indigenous peoples.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The federal government published a provisional measure this Monday (21) opening R$ 64.3 million in credit. The funds are earmarked to support food security and indigenous peoples.

The measure makes funds available for these sectors, without detailing the application criteria or the bodies responsible for managing the resources.

With the release of the credit, it is expected that there will be a strengthening of food policies and actions aimed at indigenous communities, aligned with the objective of ensuring basic subsistence conditions.

With information from Agência Brasil.
